top_violation_types.title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The most recent inspection form was not posted.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Notarized affidavit was missing on file for one out of four staff files checked.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation has not provided parents with a copy of the parent's rights form 2987 as required.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One out of four employees was missing the hazardous materials training.

top_violation_types.title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The ground is splitting open and causing a tripping hazard at the entrance to the playground.       Photos taken

top_violation_types.title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
